**v1.5.0: the battle simulator plays your battles the way the bot does.**
- **What changed.** "Can this deck beat it" (always on: it picks your boss deck) and the planner's advice now play the bot's whole chain, not only its hits, boosts and heals:
  - **Enchants.** The best one in hand (Epic, Colossal, Gargantuan, Monstrous, Giant, Strong) goes on every hit, and the kill check tries each hit without one first so the enchant is kept when it isn't needed.
  - **Defending.** When the enemies' hits could finish you this round (`defendat`, 30% by default), you get a heal if you're under 90% health, else Tower Shield, else an absorb.
  - **When nothing else goes.** Tower Shield, then an absorb that costs no pips, then Reshuffle, which puts your used cards back in the draw pile.
  - **In a party** (the planner): each blader and healer runs its whole chain too, with its Tower Shield on an ally once a battle.
- **Two fixes.** An enemy's heal spell from the wiki now heals the enemy; before, it counted as a hit on you. A deck read from the game that has absorbs but no Tower Shield no longer gets `usetower` switched off, which turned its absorbs off too.
- **Your boss deck may change.** Picks can differ for decks with heals, enchants, Tower Shields, absorbs or Reshuffles, and against enemies with heal spells. Other decks get exactly the same numbers as before.
- **Not tried in the game yet.** The game still has to show what Reshuffle brings back, whether an enchant goes on an X-pip or Hydra hit the way the bot counts it, and whether two Tower Shields stack (TODO.md, "Not in LIVE_CHECKS yet").
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
